== One Minute Of Time ==
[[File:One Minute Of Time.png|right|upright|420px]]
Instantly add one minute of time to your challenge's quest clock. Perfect for when you are so close to achieving your goals but need just one more minute! Usable in any type of challenge. Can only be used once per party per challenge.


* Acquired by:
** Killing boss monsters in any challenge. (~4-5% chance for them to drop a random challenge item), [[Bound to Character]].
** Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear and Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], [[Bound to Account]].

* Usable in all [[Challenges]].
* Can only be used once per party per challenge.
